'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Emil Wallin LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Username Darth-Link.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Darth-Link
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
